BiblicalUsage: Apostleship is the commission itself, the office and authority of being sent. Paul received grace and apostleship to bring the nations to obedience, he calls the Corinthians the seal of his apostleship, and the eleven choose Matthias to take the part of the ministry and apostleship Judas left.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe apostleship was never a title to wear, it was a charge to carry. Its seal was not a ceremony but fruit, people brought to faith and obedience by the message.
